question: In which historic battle of 1741 did the forces of the Kingdom of Travancore, led by King Marthanda Varma, decisively defeat the Dutch East India Company forces?
explanation: The Battle of Colachel was fought on August 10, 1741, between the forces of the state of Travancore under Marthanda Varma and the Dutch East India Company. The Dutch were decisively defeated, which put an end to their expansionist political designs in the Malabar/Kerala region.

question: Who was the ruler of the South Indian kingdom of Travancore who defeated the Dutch at the Battle of Colachel and consolidated his power over the pepper-growing regions of Kerala?
explanation: King Marthanda Varma (ruled 1729–1758) was the ruler of Travancore who successfully resisted Dutch commercial and military pressure, culminating in the Dutch defeat at Colachel in 1741.
